sources.snippet: This repository contains the Falcon3-7B-Base. It achieves state of art results (at the time of release) on reasoning, language understanding, instruction following, code and mathematics tasks. Falcon3-7B-Base supports 4 languages (english, french, spanish, portuguese) and a context length up to 32K.
